title: PersonaEval: Are LLM Evaluators Human Enough to Judge Role-Play?
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical capability of role identification in LLMs. While some case studies involving literary characters (such as Tom Sawyer or characters from Harry Potter) analyze dialogues centered on moral dilemmas or justice, these are used as data points for testing a model's accuracy in persona identification rather than as a benchmark for the model's own moral or ethical judgment.
